motivation: Rank-64 local-PCA residual interfaces at MLP0 and MLP1 beat all twenty same-identity Haar nulls under both suffix-KL and raw-RMS strength matching, but the exact 2^3 cube showed that early-block effects are dominated by state-dependent interactions and that MLP2 changes sign after upstream restoration. Singleton interface validity therefore does not establish joint composability.
scope: Authority-none same-realization composition test on the frozen curated-v2 ship and exact document-disjoint discovery/heldout rows. It reuses the serialized rank-64 PCA bases without refitting and mints no semantic, simplicity, predictor, training, code-OOD, fresh-corpus, or generalization license.

fixed_design.reference_cube: Complete 2^3 live exact-restoration cube over MLP0, MLP1, and MLP2, rescored in this execution.
fixed_design.projected_cube: Complete 2^3 live cube in which MLP0 and MLP1 use their frozen rank-64 local-PCA projections at absolute scale 1 and MLP2 uses unrestricted exact live restoration.
fixed_design.sequential_semantics: Every selected correction is computed at that arm's current live state in model order: MLP0, then MLP1 after any MLP0 correction, then MLP2 after any upstream corrections.
fixed_design.shared_arms: Baseline and MLP2-only are mathematically identical across cubes and may be scored once, but their paired row CE must populate both complete analyzers.
fixed_design.evaluation: No fitting or scale calibration. Score paired per-row CE on all 192 discovery and 192 heldout rows; require exact saved component-tree and row identities and reproduce the pinned exact-v2 cube rowwise before accepting projected results.
fixed_design.analysis: Apply the existing complete-cube Mobius/Shapley analyzer separately to exact and projected cubes. Positive gain means lower CE than the deployed ship.

same_currency_ratios.projected_upstream_fraction: gain(PCA0+PCA1) / gain(exact0+exact1) on the same split
same_currency_ratios.projected_joint_fraction: gain(PCA0+PCA1+exact2) / gain(exact0+exact1+exact2) on the same split

fixed_design.bootstrap: Paired 2000-draw row bootstrap for projected upstream and projected joint heldout gains; freeze seeds in implementation before execution.
fixed_design.composition_gate: Pass only if projected upstream and projected joint gains are positive on discovery and heldout; both heldout bootstrap 95% lower bounds exceed zero; projected upstream fraction is at least 0.40 on both splits; projected joint fraction is at least 0.40 on both splits; and the exact-MLP2 conditional marginal after projected upstream restoration is positive on both splits.
fixed_design.denominator_rule: Only exact arms rescored on the same realization, rows, mask, and execution may be ratio denominators. Never import the legacy 0.728-nat Shapley number or the whole-ship 0.8976-nat residual as an MLP0-2 denominator.

interpretation.pass: Licenses the frozen PCA0/PCA1 subspaces plus exact MLP2 as a coupled oracle interface for separately priced sequential coefficient prediction. It does not license independent site predictors, an MLP2 subspace, a learned program, or any OOD/training claim.
interpretation.fail: Prunes simultaneous use of the current singleton PCA interfaces at the registered scale and state semantics. Do not fit a coupled predictor through them without redesigning the interface.
interpretation.partial: Report every signed interaction and failed conjunct. In particular, a positive projected MLP0+1 gain with a nonpositive conditional MLP2 marginal means the upstream subspaces do not restore the state required by MLP2.

failure_policy: Fail closed and preserve partial artifacts in a new isolated v1 result/manifest namespace. Never overwrite the completed exact cube, PCA control, frozen realizations, or canonical FineWeb paths.
